legacy_v1_behavior: Application and legacy v1 controls keep the exact existing strict security function. V2 controls require SDK-approved exact source/runtime/closed-launch plus actual sealed source FDs and exact kernel profile; approval set remains empty.

trusted_external_control_profile.approval: Exact frozen source/runtime/launch/role and live kernel identity required; this status vector alone is never authorization.

required_live_bindings: An SDK-pinned approved producer descriptor must bind the complete control-code closure and the exact interpreter/runtime images; approval set is initially empty.

Both controller and guardian must be actual distinct live PID/birth pairs on the current boot, bound to the exact closed launch receipt and approved role entry/argv/source closure. UID, an environment label or a JSON claim cannot select a trusted role.

Whole packet/source manifests must retain the actual SDK application closure. Producer approval manifests exclude their own approval record to avoid circular self-hashes; the subject packet and its own proof are bound separately.

Validate actual /proc executable descriptors, approved runtime inputs and retained readonly source descriptors against the approved launch/source receipt. Paths or interpreter hashes alone do not establish which Python code executed.

Check observed Uid/Gid, supplementary groups and every capability/NNP/seccomp field directly from kernel procfs against the approved exact role profile. No reported application values may be substituted for actual host values.
All application VM/native/SDK processes always use the strict application profile. The external-control profile never applies to them, their helpers or arbitrary descendants.

Actual control and application leaves must belong to the same pinned nondelegated shared ancestor, with actual64GiB memory.max, zero swap and approved cpusets. Role classification never bypasses resource checks.

Controller must be the actual canonical WRITE FLOCK owner on the unchanged device/inode/birth. Independent guardian must actually retain the inherited open-file description until every owned application descendant retires.

Read guardian-self and controller-direct actual FD observations, bind controller/guardian PID/birth/executable/source identities and exact canonical descriptors; also require the live kernel FLOCK. A copied record is insufficient.

Publish one atomic admission-bound observation bundle with matching guardian/direct generation, fresh nonce/current boot/subject SHA, nonregressing sequence and age<=500ms. Any source/image/actor/FD change requires a new verified generation or retirement.
The admitted readonly context must come from the approved closed management launch and actual readonly mount topology; the application must not create, replace or choose the control approval/context.

Own exact executor/input/mount two real interruption proofs and independent physical retirement review, followed by its own bounded benign successor, remain mandatory. Metadata/schema tests never substitute for these runs.
trust_assumptions: The host OS/kernel and explicitly approved management launch are trusted. Host UID1000 generally is not an approval class.
The isolated application cannot write host source/control state, mount a substitute context, access the management socket or gain the external-control role.
Source hashing by itself is not proof of the interpreted code that ran; closed launch, source descriptors, actual image/argv and independent lifecycle evidence are required together.

implementation.source_FDs: Complete original O_RDONLY source and metadata FD set, exact F_GET_SEALS=15, actual -I -S -B bootstrap FD kernel argv, closed role entry and inherited FD args
implementation.runtime: 1346 exact fixed root-owned inputs, including9 newly reviewed ELF dependencies; actual used runtime FDs and mapped device/inode checked. R2 approval never expanded implicitly.
implementation.context: Immutable actual sealed launch context, only actual acquiring lease_owner update allowed; same-subject own original interruption and benign bindings; reject actual app-writable host-context aliases
implementation.qualification_source_approval: Exact archive/descriptor/code/runtime/current boot plus fixed SDK consumer SHA set; no product/runtime PASS is issued by this record
implementation.production_approval: Empty until actual required public positive and independent negative cases complete

source_protocol_alignment: R5 source/runtime and all authority predicates unchanged. One exact SDK17 source profile adds bounded original diagnostics. Known application AppArmor refusal remains mandatory and is not a permissions repair.
